name: 弹簧自动速开露营帐篷款

category.leaf: 弹簧自动速开双层露营帐篷

description: 弹簧自动速开、一帐多用、防水面料、便携收纳的3-4人露营帐篷

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and flat lays, light neutral #F4F7F8 for infographic screens, real outdoor grass/alpine environments for scene shots, deep navy #1F4A5C for info and CTA panels
styleLock.lightingSystem: natural soft daylight outdoors (5200-5600K) and clean high-key studio light indoors, one clear light direction per shot, soft realistic contact shadows, no harsh mixed lighting
styleLock.surfaceSystem: flat grass campsite ground, rocky alpine meadow, and seamless studio sweep
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, short bold headlines in #2D2D2D on light panels and #FFFFFF on dark or outdoor panels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and rounded rectangular info labels, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable front 3/4 hero angle and scale for the tent across the set, tent always fully pitched and never clipped unless macro
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent outdoor camping gear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, lake blue #2E9BC6, deep navy #1F4A5C and one amber-yellow accent #F2C94C; natural soft daylight outdoors and clean high-key studio light indoors with one clear light direction and soft realistic contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif short bold headlines in #2D2D2D on light panels or #FFFFFF on dark and outdoor panels; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and thin-line icon style; authentic outdoor product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable front 3/4 hero angle and scale for the tent with clean margins around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，完整轮廓干净合规
shots.camera: front 3/4 view at eye level, full pitched tent visible, not clipped by the frame
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, one soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}, a camping tent, fully pitched. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Front 3/4 view at eye level, the full tent visible and not clipped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the tent. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The tent occupies 60-70% of the frame, centered with clean even white margins on all sides. 2K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no people, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no background tint, no cut-off edges, no floating tent without contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒传达自动速开的核心利益，承接首图
shots.camera: low angle looking slightly upward at the pitched tent for scale, wide landscape environment
shots.lighting: soft natural overcast daylight from the upper left, 5500K, realistic soft shadows
shots.background: alpine rocky meadow with distant snow peaks and clean open sky #DDE9EE
shots.whitespace: open alpine composition with breathing room in the sky above the meadow
shots.textZone: headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF with a short sub-line 「{selling_point_1}」 set in the clean open sky area above the peaks
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} pitched on an alpine rocky meadow with distant snow peaks. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward to emphasize scale. Soft natural overcast daylight from the upper left, 5500K, realistic soft shadows. The tent occupies 50-60% of the frame in the lower half, leaving an open alpine sky above the peaks where the headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF and one short sub-line 「{selling_point_1}」 sit in clean white lettering. Negative: no brand logos, no invented performance numbers, no extra text, no watermark, no people, no garbled lettering, no floating tent without contact shadow.

shots.intent: 放大手工搭帐慢、下雨狼狈的痛点，反衬自动速开
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, identical camera and crop on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel dim drizzle light feeling heavy; right panel bright soft daylight, 5400K
shots.background: left panel wet campsite under drizzle, right panel dry grass campsite, unified by deep navy #1F4A5C caption strips
shots.props: loose tent poles and stakes scattered on the left panel only
shots.whitespace: balanced split-screen composition with breathing room around the scattered poles on the left and the pitched tent on the right
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #FFFFFF on deep navy strips #1F4A5C
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical camera and framing. Left panel: loose tent poles and stakes scattered on wet ground in drizzle under dim heavy light, conveying slow frustrating manual assembly, cropped so no person is visible. Right panel: {product} already fully pitched and dry in bright soft daylight. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Each panel carries one short label 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #FFFFFF on deep navy strips #1F4A5C. The product occupies 50-60% in the right panel, with balanced breathing room around the scattered poles on the left and the pitched tent on the right. Negative: no visible person or face, no fabricated statistics, no brand logos, no extra text, no watermark, no garbled lettering, no contradictory light direction between panels.

shots.intent: 代入真实露营场景，让买家自我投射
shots.camera: eye-level wide shot from a slight 3/4 angle, candid feel, tent clearly the subject
shots.lighting: soft natural daylight from the upper right, 5200K, gentle long shadows on grass
shots.background: flat grass campsite #6F9B5F with soft trees blurred in the distance
shots.props: one small camping lantern and one folded camp chair placed away from the tent, never covering it
shots.whitespace: open campsite composition with natural breathing margins of grass and sky around the tent
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle camping scene: {product} pitched on a flat green grass #7FA35C campsite with soft trees in the distance. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Eye-level wide shot from a slight 3/4 angle with a candid feel. Soft natural daylight from the upper right, 5200K, gentle long shadows on the grass. Props: one small camping lantern and one folded camp chair placed away from the tent, never covering it. The tent occupies 40-50% of the frame, set in an open campsite composition with natural breathing margins of grass and sky around it. Negative: no visible face, no hands covering the product, no brand logos, no extra text, no watermark, no cluttered campsite, no impossible shadows.

shots.intent: 讲清尺寸与容量，消除买前规格疑虑
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at the full pitched tent
shots.lighting: even flat high-key lighting, no dramatic shadow, fully readable
shots.props: thin dimension callout lines and arrows
shots.whitespace: even margins around the tent and dimension lines
shots.textZone: dimension labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #2D2D2D placed on the thin dimension lines, plus one short title 「{selling_point_1}」 at the top
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size spec infographic of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. High 45-degree angle looking down, the full pitched tent in frame with clean thin dimension callout lines and arrows. Even flat high-key lighting with no dramatic shadow. Clean light neutral background #F4F7F8. Dimension labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #2D2D2D sit on the dimension lines, plus one short title 「{selling_point_1}」 at the top. The tent occupies 65-75% of the frame with even margins around the tent and dimension lines. Negative: no invented measurement numbers, no tiny unreadable text, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no warped straight lines.

shots.intent: 微距证明速开支架结构做工，支撑自动速开主张
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro at a slight side angle, tight zoom on the central spring hub where the frame poles converge
shots.lighting: raking side light from the left revealing material texture, controlled highlight
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.textZone: one small annotation label 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D near the detail
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the central spring hub where the frame poles converge. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field at f/2.8, foreground sharp. Raking side light from the left revealing the material texture of the hub and pole tips, controlled highlight. Softly blurred neutral background #DDE3E6. The joint detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal surrounding space, detail is the whole point, and one small annotation label 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D sits near the detail. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented durability or lifespan numbers, no deformed parts, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 雨滴珠状滚落与压胶缝线微距，证明面料防雨
shots.camera: low-angle close-up along the fabric surface, tight zoom on the taped seam, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: soft diffused overcast daylight from above, 5600K, wet sheen with realistic beading reflections
shots.background: deep navy storm sky #1F4A5C softly blurred
shots.props: natural raindrops beading on the fabric
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the coated fabric surface and taped seam of {product} with raindrops beading on it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Low-angle close-up along the fabric surface, tight zoom on the taped seam, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Soft diffused overcast daylight from above, 5600K, visible beading and a wet sheen with realistic reflections. Deep navy storm sky #1F4A5C softly blurred in the background. The fabric detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal surrounding space, detail is the whole point, and one small label 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF sits near the seam. Negative: no invented waterproof ratings or test data, no blurry subject, no impossible reflections, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 并列展示两个配色，让买家按喜好选择
shots.camera: identical front 3/4 eye-level hero angle across both variants, pitched side by side
shots.lighting: identical soft even daylight across both variants, gentle shadows, no lighting drift
shots.background: clean grass field under an even bright sky, white label strip #FFFFFF at the bottom
shots.whitespace: even breathing margins of grass and sky around the two tents
shots.textZone: one short name label under each variant 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D on the white strip #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid of {product} in two colorways, colorway A #7FD0F0 and colorway B #E8B33A, pitched side by side on a clean grass field. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Identical front 3/4 eye-level camera angle and identical soft even daylight across both variants, gentle shadows. One short name label under each variant 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D on a clean white strip #FFFFFF at the bottom. The two tents together occupy 60-70% of the frame with even breathing margins of grass and sky around them. Negative: no mixed lighting between variants, no color drift, no brand logos, no extra text, no watermark, no texture loss on the lighter colorway.

shots.intent: 俯拍全套收纳与配件，讲清拿到手有什么
shots.lighting: even high-key lighting, soft minimal shadows
shots.props: carry bag, ground stakes, guy ropes and a small pouch arranged neatly in a grid
shots.whitespace: even margins around the flat lay grid
shots.textZone: one rounded info label 「{callout_1}」 listing the packing list in #1F4A5C with #FFFFFF text, and one solid rounded accent tag in #F2C94C
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen: top-down 90-degree overhead flat lay of {product} packed in its carry bag, with ground stakes, guy ropes and a small pouch arranged neatly beside it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key lighting with soft minimal shadows. Clean white background #FFFFFF. One rounded info label 「{callout_1}」 listing the packing list, set in #FFFFFF text on deep navy #1F4A5C, and one solid rounded accent tag in amber-yellow #F2C94C placed beside the grid. The packed kit occupies 65-75% of the frame with even margins around the flat lay grid. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings or test data, no fabricated badges, no fake logos, no QR codes, no watermark, no extra text.

shots.intent: 深色收口呈现售后保障与行动按钮，临门促单

shots.lighting: punchy soft studio key from the front-left with a gentle amber rim light from the right, soft contact shadow

shots.props: one solid rounded CTA button in amber-yellow #F2C94C
shots.whitespace: clean dark composition with breathing margins around the tent and the button row

shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product} pitched against a deep navy studio backdrop #1F4A5C. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 eye-level view with the tent slightly right of center. Punchy soft studio key light from the front-left with a gentle rim light in amber-yellow #F2C94C from the right, soft contact shadow grounding the tent. One short CTA line 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF sits above one solid rounded button in #F2C94C with #1F4A5C button text below the tent. provenance.notes: 从 12 张长图切片提炼：工厂实拍模糊图与二维码会员广告图丢弃，重复帐篷状态图合并；已剥离源品牌字样、slogan、二维码、模特人脸与原文案；速开时长、防雨指数、寿命次数等不可验证数据一律省略不写入模板，信任信息以可验证的实物配件与做工细节呈现，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
